name: StatusEffectsEntries
summary: The `m_lightweightLocalEffectsMap` member body of the StatusEffects replicated state in the client reader's element-count-zero branch: a prefix-varint delta count (pinned to 0), the strict zero-or-one delta, then a prefix-varint element count and that many (u16be, u64be) elements. The non-zero branch is the client's masked map; no recorded body takes it, so the card pins the count to 0 and refuses anything else.
purpose: Name the member layout the StatusEffects presence mask selects (group 1 member 1 of codec.status-effects-component-replicated-state), so the mask card references a record instead of carrying the container's layout itself.

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint count 0x144043b20 reads before it branches. It is 0 in the measured m_lightweightLocalEffectsMap body, which selects the reader's +0x78 branch 0x144045080; the non-zero masked-map branch has no instance in the recorded bundle, so the card bounds this field to 0 and refuses anything else instead of inventing the layout.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The zero-count branch 0x144045080: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60, then one prefix varint when it is 1. Measured 01 08 (delta 8). The writer delta-codes it against the previous element; what the delta indexes is not established.

fields.name: elements
fields.note: A second prefix-varint count and that many ten-byte elements, each a u16 BE followed by a u64 BE. Two elements in the measured body.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-4236.hex: 00 01 08 02 then two (u16be, u64be) pairs, 07 28 00 00 00 00 00 00 ff e5 and 01 0f 00 00 00 00 00 00 ff e5; the whole body re-encodes byte-exactly through the generated codec.
Member reader 0x144043b20 and its zero branch 0x144045080 (build 30fe6461); the u16 comes through 0x14087a360 and the u64 through 0x14087af30.
